What's Bugging You?

Full Extermination of All Those Annoying Bugs

Use the chart below to learn more about these little critters. We do it all — from residential to commercial to industrial.

Bed Bugs

Bed bugs spread fast in buildings where units share walls and hallways. Our thorough treatment gets them out of your home — and keeps them out.

Watch forBites in a line or cluster, small rust-colored spots on bedding, or a musty smell.

Termite Control

Termites do their damage quietly, in places you cannot see. We inspect for mud tubes, damaged wood and moisture problems, then treat with a plan matched to how your home is built.

Watch forMud tubes on your foundation, piles of discarded wings, or wood that sounds hollow.

Cockroach Control

Cockroaches spread fast and hide well. We treat where they actually hide — behind appliances, in wall voids, and under sinks — so the problem stops coming back.

Watch forFast-moving brown bugs that scatter when you flip on the light.

Rodent Control

Mice and rats look for food, warmth and shelter — and West New York buildings offer plenty of all three. We find where they are getting in and stop them at the source.

Watch forScratching in the walls or attic, droppings, or chewed packaging in the pantry.
